QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Yuris's Sudden Craving
QuestInfo.0: Yuris, the first elf you met in this place, has a request for you. Head over to Yuris.
QuestInfo.1: Yuris wants to eat something sweet and sour. Apparently, her friend Ellin has some fresh fruit that will fit the bill.\nGo visit #eEllin#n in #r#e#m300030010##n#k and talk about Yuris's request.

0.0: Oh...stressful situations like this make me crave something sweet! But to calm down, I need something sour! Can you help me?

yes.0:
I became friends with a fairy named Ellin some time ago. She's one of the original inhabitants of this forest.
I think she could get me some fresh fruit! Something sweet AND sour, to satisfy my cravings! I need to work on this machine, so could you go talk to her on my behalf? She should be in #r#e#m300030100##k#n.

default.0: Please hurry and ask Ellin where I can get some sweet and sour fruit! You can find Ellin in #e#m300030100##n.
